items.title: PySpark + Hudi + MinIO Local Development Setup
items.content_html:
PySpark + Hudi + MinIO Local Development Setup

An EMR 7.3-compatible local development environment built with Docker, so you can test PySpark jobs against Hudi tables on S3-compatible storage without spinning up a real EMR cluster.

items.title: Supervisor Manager: One-Command Python App Deployment
items.content_html:
Supervisor Manager: One-Command Python App Deployment

A Python tool that wraps Supervisor with templates for Flask, Streamlit, Django, FastAPI, and background services — so deploying a new app is a single command instead of hand-written config.

items.title: K3s on GCP: Free-Tier Single Node to 3-Node Cluster
items.content_html:
K3s on GCP: Free-Tier Single Node to 3-Node Cluster

Running K3s (lightweight Kubernetes) on Google Cloud Platform — starting from a completely free e2-micro single-node setup and scaling to a 3-node cluster for around $15–$18 a month.

items.title: Wake-on-LAN on an Ubuntu Laptop Server
items.content_html:
Wake-on-LAN on an Ubuntu Laptop Server

Turn on your Ubuntu laptop-server remotely with a magic packet — useful when it's tucked away and you don't want it drawing power 24/7.

items.title: 2-Laptop HA Homelab: Auto-Failover with Cloudflare + Syncthing
items.content_html:
2-Laptop HA Homelab: Auto-Failover with Cloudflare + Syncthing

Two old laptops, one primary and one failover, running Immich + Flask apps over Cloudflare Tunnel — with automatic DNS failover in 30–60 seconds when the primary drops, plus Jellyfin, Pi-hole, and Portainer for local-only services.

items.title: Setting Up an Old Ubuntu Desktop as a Home Server
items.content_html:
Setting Up an Old Ubuntu Desktop as a Home Server

Got an old Ubuntu desktop collecting dust? Here's how to repurpose it into a lean home server — disabling the GUI, locking in a static IP, setting up SSH, and managing containers with Portainer.

items.title: ClickHouse: Docker vs Kubernetes (k3d) Benchmark
items.content_html:
ClickHouse: Docker vs Kubernetes (k3d) — Benchmark

Head-to-head performance comparison of ClickHouse running in plain Docker vs ClickHouse on k3d (Kubernetes-in-Docker), using a 10M-row synthetic OLAP dataset on the same MacBook.
